title: Unhandled path: JSON lead/pct values >= 2^32 wrap positive in jint's i64->i32 cast and pass the r2 fail-fast
detail: json.Integer is i64; i32(x) truncates silently, so a lead like 4294967596 (2^32+300) wraps to 300 and passes the >0 gate. W3 closed the negative wrap; the positive wrap path is still unguarded, corrupting the displayed reaction window.
recommended_fix: Validate the i64 before truncation: parse via jint_strict-style int check, or reject when i64(x) differs from i32(x) / exceeds i32 range.
